errors: One Bash invocation exited 1 because `sed` was invoked with a stray leading comma in its expression argument (`sed -n "${n},$((n+40))p" $f`); the prior `grep -rln ... | head -1` produced a blank filename that confused the substitution.

The earlier `sed -n 60,130p apps/agent-server/src/sessions/pi-session-factory.ts` invocation also returned exit code 1, though its output was still printed; the transcript does not state the underlying cause.
